name: SuperTuxKart
hint: Online race server for the open-source kart racer, joined over IPv6

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Players turn on Connect to the Internet in Options, General, then open Online, Enter server address and type the app's address followed by :2759. No STK account is needed. The address is IPv6-only, so players need IPv6 on their network.

MAX_PLAYERS.title: Max players
MAX_PLAYERS.description: SuperTuxKart warns that more than 8 can slow the server down.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty for an open server.
